## What's Changed

### ✨ New
- **Favicon in HTML reports** — Generated reports now display a custom favicon (embedded as base64, zero external dependencies)

### 🎨 Assets
- Converted all branding images (banners, logo) from PNG to WebP — **~95% file size reduction**
- Migrated preview screenshots from `docs/` to `assets/` as WebP
- Added `assets/` directory for centralized branding: `banner_w.webp`, `banner_b.webp`, `logo.webp`, `favicon.ico`

### 📝 README
- New polished header with centered banner and navigation links
- Updated all image paths to reference `assets/` with WebP format

### Size Savings

| File | Before (PNG) | After (WebP) | Reduction |
|------|-------------|-------------|-----------|
| banner_w | 5,657 KB | 240 KB | 95.8% |
| banner_b | 1,471 KB | 80 KB | 94.6% |
| logo | 1,299 KB | 43 KB | 96.7% |
| preview-light | 268 KB | 84 KB | 68.7% |
| preview-dark | 97 KB | 55 KB | 43.3% |
| favicon | 768 KB | 2.5 KB (ICO) | 99.7% |

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rapidrabbit76/OpenCodeInsights/compare/v2026.03.04...v2026.03.06
